summary: Maximum total calls to built-in tools across the whole response, not per tool. Further tool calls the model attempts are ignored.
combines: Supported on: models supporting built-in tools
Only counts built-in tools (web search, file search, code interpreter, image_generation), not your own function tools.

Present in the Response object and the client-event schema in SDK v7.8.0; it is not declared on `ResponseCreateParamsBase` in that version's types, so passing it may need a cast even though the API accepts it.
